baseline_acceptance: 6251 / 36356489258: complete two-source package matches repository; 1024 MB / 600 s; no direct schedules; daily-morn fanout requires live route verification
observed_source_defects: Quarter comparisons use array offsets rather than validated fiscal periods, issuer identity, currencies and durations. Duplicate or missing quarters can produce fabricated YoY and acceleration.
Missing and boolean revenue/profit/expense fields enter arithmetic as zero or one; explicit zero sequential growth is discarded.
Eight statement rows produce at most three acceleration intervals, making the advertised four-quarter top tier unreachable.
One quarter multiplied by four is labelled annualized revenue and compared with currency-unqualified USD thresholds; it is not trailing-year revenue.
Source descriptions advertise earnings beat magnitude and free-cash-flow inflection, but the active calculation acquires neither corresponding source.
Original HTTP bodies, failed/unattempted request reasons and complete universe selection evidence are absent; request retries include rate limits.
Unsupported score/tier and institutional-accumulation claims flow to other engines; retained accounting observations must be separated from investment permissions.
